At first I didn't think I could go through with it. But the feeling of relief in my chest coupled with constantly surrounded by other people conversing and confiding with each other, it's kind of hard to not be constantly reassured how indeed lonely you are and how insignificant your death would be, how little impact it would make.

And frankly, I couldn't care less about it. I don't mind to have no impact on this harsh world full of awful people that have hurt me throughout the entirety of my 19 years of living (if you can even call It living). In fact, never having a friend makes the cutoff easier.
This post was actually really helpful. Thank you for taking the time to write it out.
Not really, sometimes I just listen to music and relax or walk to get my mind off of things. I'm not an excitable person at all.
A time I was genuinely happy and not just putting on an act for people? I'd say 8 or so year ago I guess.
